user.title: JustNimbus MQTT
user.description: Configure the MQTT topic prefix your JustNimbus device publishes to.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the JustNimbus MQTT broker.
data_description.port: TCP port of the JustNimbus MQTT broker (default: 1883).
data_description.topic_prefix: The root topic your JustNimbus device publishes to (default: justnimbus).
data_description.device_name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: A device with this host, port and topic prefix is already configured.

init.title: Reservoir type
init.description: Pick a standard rainwater bag ("zak") to prefill the dimensions, or choose Custom to enter them yourself.

dimensions.title: Reservoir dimensions
dimensions.description: Physical size of the rainwater reservoir ("zak"). Used to derive the fill level and the full indicator. Prefilled from your choice — adjust if needed.

data_description.reservoir_height_mm: Bag height in millimetres — the water height at which the reservoir counts as full.
data_description.reservoir_volume_l: Total bag capacity in litres — used as 100% for the fill level.
